title: OIDC: [auth.oidc_providers] config section and JWKS fetch/cache
description: Add [[auth.oidc_providers]] config: issuer, audience, username_claim (default: email). At startup: fetch JWKS from issuer's .well-known/openid-configuration. Cache JWKS in memory with configurable TTL (default 1 hour). Background refresh task. On 401 from key rotation: force-refresh JWKS before rejecting. Blocked on: stoa-e279bbe7.
